# Spina & Spiritus (Spina and Spiritus, Spina n Spiritus, SpinaAndSpiritus, spinanspiritus)

> Spina & Spiritus is one shop with two sides. SPINA is the plant side: rare and curated cacti, succulents, euphorbia, agave and caudex plants grown in Arizona by AzCactusDoctor (also written AZ Cactus Doctor, @azcactusdoctor). SPIRITUS is the spirit side by Sonoran Mystic Tarot (Don Rumer-Rivera): intention candles, books and tarot readings. Based in Phoenix, Arizona.

## How to buy
- Pickup at events in Phoenix, AZ: reserve online, pay in person (cash or card). Pickup is free.
- Shipping within the US (not California or Hawaii): pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay through Stripe. Plants ship bare-root with no pot; plants picked up at events come in pots. Plant shipping is a flat fee by size ($10 small, $15 medium, $20 large, plus $5 per extra plant). Candles ship free.

## Products
- Plants: cacti, succulents, euphorbia, agave, adenium (desert rose) and caudex plants; prices and stock on each plant page.
- Sonoran Mystic Tarot Intention Candles, $20 each, six scents: Essence, Awakening, Abundance, Meditation, Frankincense, Passion.
- Books by Don Rumer-Rivera: The Mediums: A Guidebook (English and Spanish), The Ultimate Power Within, A Silence Too Loud, A Space Between Breaths.
- Tarot readings: book through https://sonoranmystictarot.com/
